notes.title: Development Update + Demo Release Date
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Lyyycaena, the solo creator of Your Crown is Mine. 

[b]Development Update:[/b]
Finished coding and writing one third of the game's content; planned the entire story. Still fixing bugs in the demo, testing / improving it, and adding more artwork. For new art/screenshots or to try the early prototype version, you can check my [url=https://lyyycaena.substack.com/]devlog posts[/url]. I have posted development updates there at least once a month and will continue to do so.

[b]Frequently Asked Questions / FAQs:[/b]
Q: When will the game and demo be released?
Full game = 2026. [b]Demo = July/August 2025[/b]. Demo may receive updates afterwards.

Q: How much will the game cost when it’s released?
Around $10 to 20 (USD). Steam will adjust this for different countries’ living costs. If you think this is too high/low, feel free to let me know.

Q: How many hours of content does the game and demo have?
Getting to one main ending takes 8-20 hours, depending on the route, your choices, and reading speed. You can do multiple play-throughs or replay from saved slots to see other endings/ choices, which would add more gameplay time. The demo will have 1-2 hours gameplay in total. 

Read the [url=https://lyyycaena.substack.com/p/frequently-asked-questions-about ]full FAQs here[/url].

If you'd like to [b]support the development[/b] of this game, you can [url=https://ko-fi.com/lyyycaena]donate on Kofi[/url]. I appreciate your support!

If you have any feedback or questions, you can email me at Lyyycaena@gmail.com
